summary: Server one-frame request to switch gravity on for an item, with the instigator; read by esv::GravitySystem (and GravitySystemHelper::SetItemGravity per the macOS names). Written by the per-frame update of esv::ItemManager (bg3.exe+0x33AC3B0) and restored from saves (model game.gravity.v0.SetGravityActiveRequestOneFrameComponent, 16 bytes; loader bg3.exe+0x25D77A0). Same layout as SE's esv::SetGravityActiveRequest (Components\Data.h: bool Active; EntityHandle Instigator). Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).
